title: Would you rather go 3 days without sleep, or 3 days without water?
lines: One of these can kill you in hours.
Would you rather go three days without sleep, or three days without water?
Pick one right now, and comment A or B. Think fast.
Option [A](eh): no sleep. By hour seventeen, your brain is already slipping.
Experts compare it to a blood alcohol level of point oh five.
At twenty-four hours, it's like point one oh. Over the driving limit.
Your brain dozes off for seconds at a time, and you might not notice.
By day three, many people start seeing things that aren't there.
San Diego, [1963](nineteen sixty-three). Randy Gardner, seventeen, tries to stay awake.
He makes it eleven days. Moody, forgetful, even paranoid by the end.
Then he sleeps over fourteen hours, and he recovers.
Guinness later stopped tracking this [record](reckerd). Too dangerous.
Option B: no water. Your body is about sixty percent water.
In serious heat, you can sweat out over a liter an hour. That's three soda cans.
Your blood volume drops, your heart races, and your brain cells shrink.
Then your kidneys, your body's water filter, start to fail.
Lose a tenth of your weight in water, about two gallons, and your life is in danger.
In a cool room, you might last a week. In extreme heat, only hours.
By the science, option [A](eh) wins. No sleep is miserable, but you bounce back.
So choose carefully, because
